integrity: The analytic proof is complete conditional only on the standard quadratic Gauss-sum evaluation; finite enumerations are cross-checks, not proofs for arbitrary primes. Related 2026 small-prime histograms explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Canonical quadratic-chirp MUBs over odd prime fields only; arbitrary MUBs, larger submatrices and nonprime prime powers are excluded.
title: Exact Bargmann-phase histograms and three-column spectra for prime quadratic-chirp bases
